text:
sam: Quick sync needed on reserved-pool autoscale policy before we freeze the Q3 rollout. We have customer asks for regional burst guarantees + predictable latency.
leila: tl;dr — customers want: guaranteed 99th latency under burst, and a soft burst budget that doesn’t blow committed spend.
chen: can we meet 99th P95 at scale without prewarming everywhere? probably not. need tiered prewarm + predictive ramp.
deepa: +1, but ops impact: more prewarm = more warm GPUs = cost. need launch signal metrics and an ops rollback path.
mike_sales: ACME and BetaBank are pushing for a documented SLA. If we don’t offer it they'll force dedicated private deployments.
sam: proposal sketch: two-tier autoscale policy for reserved pools — "steady" (baseline commit) + "surge" (soft burst credits). Surge rules: 15% of committed RUs per day by default, configurable.
leila: that 15% number came from heuristics. We should make it per-tenant sliding window (24h) and also cap concurrent surge slots.
chen: implementation notes: recommend continuous batching + per-tenant KV cache pinning during surge. Also need admission control so bursts don’t evict latency-critical tenants.
deepa: ops/playbook: add a circuit-breaker when queue latency > X for > 2m. Fallback policy: route to compatible lower-cost model or cross-region spill with degraded SLA.
sam: launch criteria checklist (draft):
- telemetry: per-tenant 90/95/99 latency, token cost, surge consumption visible in console
- canary: 3 pilots across regions (us-west, eu-west, ap-south) for 2 weeks
- safety: automated fallback + ops alerting + documented customer-facing SLA wording
- billing: burst accounting + clear invoicing for overage
leila: suggest adding: quality gate — no regression on end-to-end eval prompts during surge (measure hallucination and latency tail).
chen: config snippet for policy (proto):
```json
{
  "policy_name": "tiered_reserved_autoscale_v1",
  "steady_capacity_ratio": 1.0,
  "surge_credit_pct_per_24h": 15,
  "concurrent_surge_slots": 3,
  "prewarm_strategy": "predictive+on-demand",
  "fallback": "regional_spill|model_variant"
}
```
mike_sales: question — is surge_credit_pct customizable per contract? customers will want higher for premium plans.
sam: yes — default 15%, negotiable up to 50% for high-commit tiers with price uplift. Need to capture that in pricing doc.
deepa: operational cost estimate request: can infra team model expected GPU-hours for 15% surge across top 20 tenants? that will drive cost+pricing.
chen: will run simulation. need historical traffic windows from billing + per-tenant QPS distribution. target by end of week.
sam: decision points we need to resolve this week:
1) default surge % and whether per-day sliding window is the right unit
2) hard cap on concurrent surge slots (safety)
3) telemetry events + console UI surface (who owns)
4) rollout plan + pilot tenants
leila: I can own telemetry UI mocks. chen will own infra simulation. deepa owns runbooks & fallback automation. sam will coordinate pilots & pricing.
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout created for policy "tiered_reserved_autoscale_v1" on staging at 2024-07-19T16:00Z.
sam: ok great — next steps: chen posts simulation numbers, leila posts UI mocks, deepa posts runbook draft. We’ll reconvene Fri 10am PT. If anyone needs to change assignments ping me. :thumbsup:
